svg.title: SMSMitra features
svg.desc: Animated cards: SIM management, SMS dispatch, scheduling engine, reports, and security and resilience.

g.text: Per-SIM daily quota to avoid throttling
SIM health synced to the server
Instant send via REST API or app UI
Logs with time, number, SIM & failure reason
Daily stats: Total / Sent / Pending / Failed
Branded delivery reports, generated on the fly
Foreground service + WAKE_LOCK stop Android from killing the gateway app.
